asset.coordinateNotes: Y-up. Front direction is +Z in the generated model.
intendedUse: future kagura glTF runtime import test

acceptance.notes: Geometry comparison should be near-zero. Material comparison is allowed to drift because GLB PBR and OBJ/MTL shading are different renderer paths.

styleContract.target: rough low-poly character blockout for proportion and scale checks

kaguraIntegrationPlan.stage1: Use vlmkit to generate fixed render snapshots for GLB assets before they are imported into kagura.
kaguraIntegrationPlan.stage2: Use GLB as the primary handoff format because kagura exposes glTF loading and 2D/3D renderer boundaries.
kaguraIntegrationPlan.stage3: Keep OBJ/MTL as a debugging export only; do not make it the runtime asset format unless kagura needs it.
kaguraIntegrationPlan.stage4: Add a kagura-side visual smoke test that renders the same front/side/back/iso camera presets and compares against vlmkit snapshots.
